purpose: Fresh response-blind real-system validation of calibration-only selective promotion of EOG contextual Layer B.

source.title: Standardized camera trapping data from National Ecological Observatory Network (NEON) subprojects and other forest plots.

authorized_operations: read public file names, sizes, checksums, content links, record/version metadata

scientific_boundary.validation_target: Does calibration-only selective promotion transfer known-truth support into a fresh real ecological prediction without using outer-heldout outcomes for promotion?
scientific_boundary.primary_comparison_if_future_gates_pass: baseline-only versus selectively promoted baseline-plus-contextual-Layer-B on untouched outer heldout

no_rescue: Do not open camera_trap_sequences.csv before target, split, model, feature, and selector contracts are frozen.
Do not switch target taxon after any biological-response value is opened.
Do not change the source record/version or substitute another file after a failed live gate within this attempt.
Do not classify pre-response transport or schema failure as favorable, null, or adverse predictive evidence.
